## About
Mike's Brake & Alignment is a completely family owned and operated auto repair shop on N Beach Street in Fort Worth. Fonzie is the owner and technician, and he and Lilia run the shop and the office together.
We specialize in brakes and alignments, but we work on all makes and models and handle a long list of other repairs and maintenance. Our goal is simple: keep you happy with the work and safe on the road, and build the kind of relationship where you come back because you trust us.
Most folks hear about us from a friend. Don't worry about being pressured; we reserve that for the air in your tires. Neighbors have given us a 4.5 rating across 104 Google reviews.

## Services
- Brake services: Brake repair and service from a technician who focuses on brake systems.
- Alignment and tires: Wheel alignment plus tire service, repairs and sales to help your tires wear evenly and last longer.
- Steering and suspension: Front end suspension, shocks and struts, and power steering work.
- State inspections: We're an approved state inspection station.
- Engine light and ABS diagnostics: If a warning light is on, we can find out why and fix it.
- Oil changes: Conventional and synthetic oil changes.
- A/C service and repair: Air conditioning service and repairs.
- Transmission and engine work: Transmission services plus transmission and engine installs.
- Battery, starter and alternator repairs: Repairs for your battery, starter and alternator.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my kind of car?
A: Fonzie services and repairs all makes and models. If you're unsure, give us a call.

Q: Can I get an estimate?
A: Yes. Call us for a free estimate, or stop by the shop and we'll take a look.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday from 7:30 am to 5:30 pm, open Saturday mornings, and closed Sunday. Give us a call to confirm before you come in.
